Type.evidence_source: A total of 10 people participated in the study after being asked and informed by specialists in psychology at three emergency psychiatric units and one crisis resolution team.

Area.evidence_source: The participants must (a) have been considered seriously suicidal, but in the event of a suicide attempt, the interview needed to take place no earlier than 2 weeks afterwards; Of the 10 participants, 9 had made suicide attempts prior to the interview, and one of them had tried four times during the previous month. Four of the interviewees had made one or more attempts in the past. All had used drugs as the method in the attempted suicides. Five revealed that they had consumed alcohol prior to or concurrently with taking the drugs. One participant had not attempted suicide, but was prevented from carrying out a carefully planned suicide by being hospitalized.
